notes: Variant WLC.2KI.9.15.v001 (s039–s040) underdetermined, base reading compatible; aligned as printed.

'let none escape and go forth': אַל → none (rule 15 negation recast onto the subject nominal), פָּלִיט → escape, supplied and added; the alternative of reading 'escape' with the jussive was considered and set aside because 'go forth' already writes יָצָא.
